mapper.sql: goods_spu . id , goods_spu.`name`, goods_spu.sub_title, goods_spu.spu_urls, goods_spu.`status`, goods_spu.sales_volume, goods_spu.category_first_id, goods_spu.category_second_id, goods_spu.create_time, goods_spu.update_time, goods_spu.del_flag, goods_spu.description, goods_spu.enable_specs, goods_spu.stock, goods_spu.freight_type, goods_spu.fixed_freight_price, goods_spu.sales_price, goods_spu.original_price, goods_spu.cost_price
mapper.select:
SELECT , goods_category.name AS categoryName FROM goods_spu AS goods_spu LEFT JOIN goods_category AS goods_category ON goods_spu.category_second_id = goods_category.id
AND goods_spu.`del_flag` = '0'
AND LOWER(goods_spu.`name`) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{query.name}),'%')
AND goods_spu.`status` = #{query.status}

SELECT
FROM goods_spu as `goods_spu` WHERE goods_spu.`id` =#{id} AND goods_spu.`del_flag` = '0'

SELECT
FROM goods_spu AS goods_spu where goods_spu.id = #{id}

SELECT
FROM goods_spu AS goods_spu where goods_spu.id = #{id} AND goods_spu.del_flag = '0' AND goods_spu.status = '1'

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.sub_title, g.spu_urls, COUNT(f.id) AS view_count FROM goods_spu g LEFT JOIN goods_footprint f ON g.id = f.spu_id AND f.del_flag = '0' WHERE g.del_flag = '0' AND g.status = '1' GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.sub_title, g.spu_urls ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT 10;
